defects.what: The UI Workflow 'Bad' example still names PriorityMatrixPage, which this change renamed to PrioritiesPage.
PrioritiesPageData extends the service-layer MatrixData, so src/types now depends on src/services, unlike BoardData and ProjectsPageData which are built from DAL types.
pageContext is declared between two render functions, whereas ProjectsPage and PrioritiesPage declare it after the handlers and before the render functions.
The same toPrioritiesPageProps({tasks, activePlan}, SCENARIO_TODAY) call is spelled out seven times; a fixture helper would read better.
The activePlanId prop doc says 'The week the task could be tracked into' but the value is a plan id.
